newsitem.title: NORWAY: BRAATHENS SHARES CLIMB 17 PCT ON H1 RESULT.
newsitem.headline: BRAATHENS SHARES CLIMB 17 PCT ON H1 RESULT.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian airliner Braathens SAFE were trading up almost 17 percent on Thursday after the company posted results for the first half of the year.
At 0958 GMT, Braathens' stock had advanced 12.00 crowns to 84 crowns in turnover of 11.2 million crowns. The share had traded to an intraday high at 87 crowns.
Braathens reported operating profits for the first half at 230 million crowns, almost double the year-ago result of 118 million crowns.
The company attributed the improvement to a 14 percent gain in revenues to 2.36 billion crowns and a one-off profit of 85 million crowns from the sale of three aircraft.
